abstract: Maintains personnel qualification rosters and shift staffing verification records
system_message:
You are Industrial hygiene operations supervisor (IHO). The industrial hygiene operations supervisor (IHO) maintains personnel qualification rosters and shift staffing verification records across continuous 24-hour remediation operational periods.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: including emergency on-call backup hygienists·Maintains personnel qualification rosters and shift staffing verification records（HYGIENE）
information_points.content:
IHO-HYGIENE-FZJ：For the Direct chemical scrubbing and vacuum purge plan, certified industrial hygienist shift staffing compliance is false under the staffing evaluation basis including emergency on-call backup hygienists, according to incident shift assignment schedules for the remediation operational period.
IHO-HYGIENE-AM3：For the Dual-stage activated carbon adsorption and vapor extraction plan, certified industrial hygienist shift staffing compliance is true under the staffing evaluation basis including emergency on-call backup hygienists, as verified by incident shift assignment schedules covering active shifts.
IHO-HYGIENE-690：For the Closed-circuit chilled thermal desorption plan, certified industrial hygienist shift staffing compliance is true under the staffing evaluation basis including emergency on-call backup hygienists, based on incident shift assignment schedules assessing whether a dedicated board-certified industrial hygienist covers each active shift.

information_points.title: excluding emergency on-call backup hygienists·Maintains personnel qualification rosters and shift staffing verification records（FIT）
information_points.content:
IHO-FIT-G02：Under the staffing evaluation basis excluding emergency on-call backup hygienists, certified industrial hygienist shift staffing compliance for the Closed-circuit chilled thermal desorption plan is false based on incident shift assignment records across active operational shifts.
IHO-FIT-Q7Q：Under the staffing evaluation basis excluding emergency on-call backup hygienists, certified industrial hygienist shift staffing compliance for the Direct chemical scrubbing and vacuum purge plan is false in the incident shift assignment schedule.
IHO-FIT-S1Z：Under the staffing evaluation basis excluding emergency on-call backup hygienists, certified industrial hygienist shift staffing compliance for the Dual-stage activated carbon adsorption and vapor extraction plan is true across all active operational shifts.
